arxiv-2411-11807.title: Shadow Images of Ghosh-Kumar Rotating Black Hole Illuminated By Spherical Light Sources and Thin Accretion Disks
arxiv-2411-11807.creator: Chen-Yu Yang, M. Israr Aslam, Xiao-Xiong Zeng, Rabia Saleem
arxiv-2411-11807.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Chen-Yu Yang, M. Israr Aslam, Xiao-Xiong Zeng, Rabia Saleem. This study investigates the astronomical implications of the Ghosh-Kumar rotating Black Hole (BH), particularly its behaviour on shadow images, illuminated by celestial light sources and equatorial thin accretion disks. Our research delineates a crucial correlation between dynamics of the shadow images and the parameters a a , q q and the θ o ​ b ​ s \theta_{obs} , which aptly reflect the influence of the model parameters on the optical features of shadow images.

arxiv-2412-20989.title: New Black Hole Solutions of Second and First Order Formulations of Nonlinear Electrodynamics
arxiv-2412-20989.description: Abstract Inspired by the so-called Palatini formulation of General Relativity and of its modifications and extensions, we consider an analogous formulation of the dynamics of a self-interacting gauge field which is determined by non-linear extension of Maxwell’s theory, usually known as nonlinear electrodynamics.

arxiv-2504-13675.title: Exploring Charge Density Waves in two-dimensional NbSe 2 with Machine Learning
arxiv-2504-13675.creator: Norma Rivano, Francesco Libbi, Chuin Wei Tan, Christopher Cheung, Jose L. Lado, Arash Mostofi, Philip Kim, Johannes Lischner, Adolfo O. Fumega, Boris Kozinsky, Zachary A. H. Goodwin
arxiv-2504-13675.description: Abstract Niobium diselenide (NbSe 2 ) has garnered significant attention due to the coexistence of superconductivity and charge density waves (CDWs) down to the monolayer limit. However, realistic modeling of CDWs—capturing effects such as layer number, twist angle, and strain—remains challenging due to the high computational cost of first-principles methods.

arxiv-2507-14875.title: The population of hyperluminous X-ray sources as seen by XMM-Newton
arxiv-2507-14875.creator: Roberta Amato, Erwan Quintin, Hugo Tranin, Andrés Gúrpide, Natalie Webb, Olivier Godet, Gian Luca Israel, Matteo Imbrogno, Elias Kammoun, Maitrayee Gupta
arxiv-2507-14875.description: Abstract Context. Ultraluminous and hyperluminous X-ray sources (ULXs and HLXs) are among the brightest astrophysical objects in the X-ray sky. While ULXs most likely host stellar-mass compact objects accreting at super-Eddington rates, HLXs are compelling candidates for accreting intermediate-mass black holes.

pmc-11292692.title: Evaluation of the national AIDS program and HIV/AIDS surveillance system in Jordan
pmc-11292692.creator: Moad J Al-Rahamneh, Yousef Khader, Ashraf Jamil Aqel, Hiba Abaza, Srinath Satyanarayana, Ala’a Fuad Al-Shaikh, Heyam Hilal Mukattash, Areej Hamed Shoubaki, Tareq Haytham Aldamen
pmc-11292692.description: Introduction:The National AIDS Program in Jordan has faced numerous challenges, including insufficient funding, limited resources, and complexities brought on by refugee influxes. The absence of a reliable HIV/AIDS surveillance system further complicates tracking and responding to the epidemic. This study aimed to evaluate the performance and functionality of the National AIDS Program and the HIV/AIDS surveillance system.

pmc-12931921.title: Transcutaneous Electrical Nerve Stimulation vs Transcutaneous Electrical Nerve Stimulation With Music in Persistent Low-Back Pain: Protocol for a Pilot Feasibility Trial
pmc-12931921.creator: Seema Radhakrishnan, Michael Glynn, Anne-Marie Robertson, Anna Fedyczkowski, Lieu Trinh, Sabrina Naz, Javad Sarvestan
pmc-12931921.description: BackgroundTranscutaneous electrical nerve stimulation (TENS) works on the principle of the gate control theory of pain and is used as a nonpharmacological pain management intervention. Music therapy or listening to self-selected music has also been shown to reduce pain intensity, anxiety, and depression. There has been no published literature that has explored whether these modalities can work synergistically.
